title: Completion record
description: Where the work on a feature stands, as the implementer states it: .agents/completion/<issue>.json, which Git ignores. It is the only source the completion gate (scripts/lib/completion.sh, completion_gate) reads for remaining work, and the only source of the triage implementer's check of each finding to fix; the handoff note is for people and the next session, and no script parses its sections for either. The generic validator of scripts/lib/guardrails.sh checks a record against this schema; the rules across fields that a schema cannot express (the status follows from the criteria and from what remains, pending only at a later gate, owner_approval never met, no partial run of the checks or budget check as evidence) stay in completion_errors. The record is a claim of the implementer, which the independent review checks against the code and the tests.

status.description: complete: every criterion met or not applicable, nothing remaining. awaiting_evidence: the same, with at least one criterion pending at a later gate. partial: work remains. blocked: the implementer cannot go on without a decision of the human.

criteria.description: One entry for every acceptance criterion of the Issue, in its words, and for every step of the feature plan that no criterion covers.

gate.description: Where the evidence of the criterion can exist; implementation when it is left out.

evidence.description: The test, file, or command that shows the criterion; for not_applicable the reason, for not_met where the work stands, for pending the gate at which the evidence appears.

remaining.description: What is left, one text per item: empty for complete and awaiting_evidence, not empty for partial and blocked. The completion gate reads remaining work from here and from nowhere else.

checks.description: The triage implementer's check of each FIX_NOW finding it was given (.agents/prompts/triage-implementer.md): one entry per finding and triage, kept across the rounds. Only fixed, with its evidence, resolves a finding; two entries for one finding of one triage that differ in value or evidence conflict and leave it open. The entries are the implementer's statement: the next review and its triage receive them as data.

triage.description: The file name of the approved triage that named the finding, as apply-triage.sh gives it, such as feature-12-recipes-review-01-triage.json.

finding.description: The finding's id as the review gives it, such as M1 or MIN2.

evidence.description: The test or command that shows the value, and its result. A none-word, or delimiters and punctuation alone, are no evidence.

risk.description: The implementer's own classification of the feature (scripts/lib/risk.sh). It can raise the level the scripts compute from the diff, never lower it.
